seedResources.name: PDF Document Analysis Skill
seedResources.description: A reusable OAN Skill for PDF document parsing, text extraction, metadata inspection, and source-oriented document analysis. It is intended for agents that need to read PDF files, extract structured content, and prepare downstream summaries or evidence snippets.
seedResources.capabilityDescription: Parse PDF documents, extract text and metadata, identify pages and sections, and provide document-analysis outputs that can be consumed by an agent workflow.
useCaseExamples: 我需要一个可以帮助智能体处理 PDF 文档、提取内容并做文档分析的技能
Extract text and metadata from a PDF file before summarization
Analyze a report PDF and return page-level evidence snippets

examples.task: 解析 PDF 文档并提取正文

seedResources.name: Everything Local File Search MCP Server
seedResources.description: An MCP Server that exposes local file search capabilities through the Model Context Protocol. It is suitable for desktop agents that need to query a Windows Everything index, locate files by keyword, and return paths or file metadata through MCP tools.
seedResources.capabilityDescription: Provide MCP tool calls for local file discovery, filename keyword search, path lookup, and desktop automation workflows that need reliable file retrieval.
useCaseExamples: 需要一个 MCP server，在 Windows 上通过 Everything 做 local file search
Find local documents by filename from an agent workflow
Use MCP to search a developer workstation for project files

examples.task: 搜索本地文件名中包含 report 的文档
MCP local file search for README files

seedResources.name: Open-Meteo Forecast Tool API
seedResources.description: A Tool/API resource for public weather forecast queries. It provides HTTPS access to current and forecast weather data such as temperature, rainfall, wind speed, and structured JSON responses for agent applications.
seedResources.capabilityDescription: Call a public weather forecast API, retrieve current conditions and future forecasts, and use JSON outputs in travel planning, alerting, or automation tasks.
useCaseExamples: 查询某个城市未来几天的天气预报和风速
public HTTPS API for weather forecast current temperature wind speed JSON
Get rainfall forecast for travel planning

examples.task: 查询北京明天是否下雨
Get current temperature and wind speed

seedResources.name: A2A Hello World Agent Service
seedResources.description: A minimal Agent Service used to verify Agent2Agent connectivity, agent card inspection, and simple request-response integration. It is useful as a reference resource for checking whether an agent platform can discover and call an A2A endpoint.
seedResources.capabilityDescription: Expose an A2A-compatible endpoint, publish agent card information, and support simple connectivity or hello-world tests before deeper integration.
useCaseExamples: 找一个可以用于连通性测试的 A2A 智能体服务，最好有 agent card
Inspect an A2A agent card before integration
Run a hello-world request against an agent service endpoint

examples.task: 测试 A2A 智能体服务是否可连通
examples.output: Connectivity status and agent card metadata

seedResources.name: Inference MCP Server
seedResources.description: An MCP Server resource that exposes inference-oriented tool access for agent workflows. It represents a network service that can be discovered by capability and protocol metadata rather than by a fixed vendor-specific integration.
seedResources.capabilityDescription: Provide MCP-based inference calls and structured tool responses for agents that need to delegate model inference or related computation through an interoperable service interface.
useCaseExamples: Find an MCP server for inference tasks
需要一个能够提供模型推理能力的 MCP 服务
Route an agent workflow to an inference tool endpoint

examples.task: 调用推理 MCP 服务完成模型计算

seedResources.name: 中文合同风险审查技能
seedResources.description: 面向中文合同文本的智能体技能资源，可用于识别付款条款、违约责任、终止条件、保密义务和合规风险。该资源适合需要对中文合同进行初步审查、风险摘要和证据定位的智能体工作流。
seedResources.capabilityDescription: 对中文合同内容进行条款级风险识别，输出风险清单、风险原因和相关段落位置，辅助后续人工审核或智能体自动化处理。
useCaseExamples: 帮我审查一份中文合同里的付款风险和违约责任
识别合同里的终止条款风险并生成风险清单
Find risky clauses in a Chinese commercial contract

examples.output: 风险条款、风险等级、证据段落
